title: The 6 Best Leaf Blowers for Small Yards
h1: The 6 Best Leaf Blowers for Small Yards
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for leaf blowers for small yards, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at leaf blowers for small yards using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EGO Power+ LB6504 650 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 56V ARC Lithium battery, 5.0Ah included, Up to 650 CFM turbo airflow, 250 to 500 CFM variable-speed dial.
strengths: 650 CFM clears a small yard in a single fast pass
Variable dial keeps everyday cleanup quieter than full turbo
5-year tool warranty is the longest of any blower in this roundup
Battery works across 100-plus EGO 56V outdoor tools
limitations: At roughly 6.2 lbs with the battery installed, it's the heaviest handheld pick here
Turbo mode drains the included 5.0Ah pack in well under an hour
features: Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge

products.name: Greenworks 40V 185 MPH 340 CFM Cordless Blower/Vacuum
products.blurb: Key specs: 185 MPH / 340 CFM brushless motor, 2-in-1 blower and vacuum with collection bag, Includes 4.0Ah battery and charger.
strengths: Lightest full package here at 7.3 lbs, easy for longer sessions
Vacuum mode with bag doubles as light leaf collection on the same charge
Battery and charger included at a price below the EGO and Ryobi kits
3-year warranty on tool and battery
limitations: 340 CFM trails the EGO and Toro on heavy or wet leaf piles
Vacuum bag needs frequent emptying on anything but a small lawn
Single-speed vacuum mode versus the blower's variable speed
features: 2-in-1 blower and vacuum with collection bag
Compatible with the Greenworks 40V battery system

products.name: Ryobi 40V HP Brushless Whisper Series 650 CFM Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 40V HP Brushless motor, 650 CFM / 160 MPH, Whisper Series low-noise housing, Variable-speed trigger with cruise control lock.
strengths: Noticeably quieter than the EGO and Greenworks at comparable airflow
Cruise control trigger lock reduces hand fatigue on longer cleanups
650 CFM keeps pace with the EGO LB6504 at a lower typical street price
Battery shared across Ryobi's wide 40V mower, trimmer, and blower lineup
limitations: Most listings sell it tool-only, with battery and charger priced separately
Amazon stock and bundle availability is less consistent than Home Depot's
1-year tool warranty is shorter than the EGO's 5-year coverage
features: Variable-speed trigger with cruise control lock
Turbo button for maximum clearing power
Shares Ryobi's 40V outdoor tool battery platform

products.name: Toro PowerJet F700 Corded Electric Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 725 CFM airflow, 140 MPH air speed, 12-amp motor, Variable-speed dial.
strengths: No battery to charge and no runtime limit as long as it's plugged in
725 CFM handles heavier leaf piles than any cordless pick here
Lightest blower in this roundup since there's no battery pack to carry
Typically the least expensive option new
limitations: Cord length limits range, extension cords required for anything beyond a small lot
Louder at full power than the Ryobi Whisper Series
Not practical for gutter cleaning far from an outlet

products.name: WORX WG547 20V Cordless Turbine Leaf Blower
strengths: Light and easy to handle
Turbine fan design
Battery and charger included
PowerShare battery platform
limitations: Not for big wet leaf piles

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX Cordless Leaf Blower (LSW221)
strengths: Very light and easy to use
Battery and charger included
Good for sweeping hard surfaces
Affordable
limitations: Low airflow for lawns full of leaves

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
